title_zh: 哈密市医疗保障局就完善生育保障措施公开征求意见
title_en: Hami Medical Security Bureau Solicits Public Opinions on Improving Maternity Benefits
summary_zh: 哈密市医疗保障局拟定生育保障措施通知稿，自7月22日起公开征求意见，以完善生育保险制度、提高保障水平。
summary_en: Hami Medical Security Bureau drafted a notice on maternity protection measures and opened public consultation from July 22 to improve the maternity insurance system and raise protection levels.
body_zh:
